column1: # nice-dns provider routes (ARCH-04). Parsed as data by lib/recovery.sh and
# tests; never sourced. The first data row names the schema.
# Columns (tab-separated): route  port  tls_name  provider  class
#   port      the proxy listener; the address comes from the platform adapter
#             (Linux 127.0.0.1 in the pod, macOS the proxy container address)
#   tls_name  the name Unbound authenticates on every session of this route
#   class     identity: an identity-bound route, one provider, never switches
#             compat:   the legacy :853 endpoint, Cloudflare-only in the
#                       Sub-plan 2 proxy images; the image default route
